positions.title: Applied AI Engineer
positions.description:
Built RAG and AI-agent solutions on the Vectara platform for enterprise customers, combining hybrid retrieval (BM25 and dense embeddings), reranking, and tool-calling agents in Python and TypeScript.
Ran LLM evaluation using open-rag-eval and Vectara's HHEM-based Factual Consistency Score to measure retrieval quality and response grounding.
Tuned chunking, metadata filtering, and reranker settings to improve retrieval precision and query latency.
Partnered directly with customer engineering teams to scope use cases and build ingestion pipelines and REST API integrations (FastAPI, PostgreSQL) for enterprise data sources.
Shipped customer solutions across SaaS and VPC environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions CI/CD, with observability dashboards tracking answer quality, latency, and cost per query.
achievements: Delivered RAG and AI-agent solutions for 8 enterprise customers, raising answer accuracy to 88%.
Cut hallucination rate from 9% to 3% across 6 production use cases through LLM evaluation and grounding checks.
Lifted retrieval precision@5 by 18% and reduced p95 query latency from 2.8 s to 1.4 s.
Moved 5 customer deployments from proof of concept to production.

positions.title: AI/NLP Engineer
positions.description:
Built and shipped NLP models for intent classification, entity extraction, and disambiguation (PyTorch, Hugging Face transformers) powering AI co-workers for BFSI, telecom, and HR clients.
Developed document-extraction pipelines for invoices, contracts, and resumes, combining OCR, layout parsing, and named-entity recognition.
Engineered Python and Java backend APIs and workflow orchestration connecting AI co-workers to client ERP, HRMS, and CRM systems.
Built training, evaluation, and retraining pipelines with versioned datasets, MLflow tracking, and regression test suites.
Worked on-site with enterprise client teams to map processes and run UAT, including on-premise installs for data-sensitive customers.
achievements: Lifted intent accuracy to 92% across 15 deployments.
Cut manual document processing time by 60%.
Served 50K+ requests per day at 99.5% uptime.
Shortened model update cycles from 3 weeks to 4 days.
Took 12 automations from pilot to production.
